total_return_swap_trs.text:
`caplet_floorlet_pricer_black` answers "what is a single option on a forward interest rate worth?" It prices a caplet (a call on the forward rate) or a floorlet (a put) under the Black lognormal model, so it needs a `strike`, a `vol` and an `expiry` alongside `forward_rate`, `notional`, `accrual` and `discount_factor`.

`total_return_swap_trs` answers "what is one leg of a total-return swap worth?" It values the receiver's position: the asset's period return minus the financing rate over the accrual period, discounted. It has no option features, so it takes `asset_return` and `financing_rate` instead of a strike or volatility, and it has a `receive_total_return` flag for direction.

In short, `caplet_floorlet_pricer_black` values optionality on a rate, while `total_return_swap_trs` values a straightforward exchange of asset return against financing.

explain.text: `caplet_floorlet_pricer_black` prices a single caplet or floorlet under the Black (lognormal) model. A caplet is a call on the forward rate and a floorlet is a put, selected with `option_type` (default `"caplet"`). You supply `notional`, `forward_rate`, `strike`, `vol`, `expiry`, `accrual` and `discount_factor`, and pyvar computes the price. By put-call parity, a long caplet and a short floorlet at the same strike replicate a payer FRA, which is a handy consistency check.

when.text:
`caplet_floorlet_pricer_black` fits when you need the value of one caplet or floorlet under the Black (lognormal) model.

- You have a single option on a forward rate: a caplet (a call on the rate) or a floorlet (a put), set with `option_type`.
- You can supply a Black volatility (`vol`) for the forward rate, along with `forward_rate`, `strike`, `expiry`, `accrual`, `discount_factor` and `notional`.
- You want to check put-call parity: a caplet and floorlet at the same strike replicate a payer FRA.
- You want a single building block rather than a whole cap or floor.

Related function: `cap_floor_pricer` prices an interest-rate cap/floor as a strip of caplets/floorlets.
